'''Z-Alpha Squadron''' was a [[TIE/ad starfighter]] unit in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] that defected to rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|splinter government]] [[Zaarin's fleet|fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In the [[Zaarin insurrection]], they fought the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] but were ultimately defeated. The engagements that the squadron took part in included the [[Battle of Imperial Center|battle]] at [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]], which was the Grand Admiral's attempt to capture [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
